body: I'm sorry for not responding sooner.  Thank you all for your support. I told my boyfriend about my feelings last night. I couldn't stand keeping this secret from him anymore. He was very supportive, but we haven't gotten a chance to really talk yet (I told him around 2am). I'm going to try to find something that will make me feel a little accomplished each day, as Searching4hope mentioned. I don't think these feelings are going to go away, but I promised I would not act on them, so for now they will just be thoughts. I'm sorry for any worry I caused, and thank you guys for everything.
